title: Input types and validation
description: Use email, number and text constraints with the browser's built-in validation model; distinguish helpful client feedback from authoritative server validation.
objectives: Select appropriate native input types and constraints
Explain how checkValidity and reportValidity differ
Observe invalid form behavior without sending a request
Describe why backend validation must repeat all security-critical checks
rubric: I added appropriate types and browser constraints to each input.
I tested at least one invalid and one valid case using the browser's validity API.
I explained why backend validation remains mandatory.
